watch.summary: A streamer reacts with awe to a clip of cinematic, movie-like combat footage.

beats.what: Streamer watches gameplay footage featuring an elevator transition into a shootout.
The character shoots an enemy at point-blank range as elevator doors close.
Streamer smiles in amazement and says 'That is insane'.

watch.author: game_itself
watch.why: This clip showcases slick cinematic action gameplay rather than comedy. The streamer's reaction is purely genuine awe at the video rather than a comedic setup or punchline.
